OKF provides an open, non-proprietary standard that decouples repository memory from any single proprietary tool.
Agent instructions files (`AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`) direct agents to check `openwiki/quickstart.md` before taking action.
Post-launch telemetry and community feedback revealed developers were using OpenWiki markdown files directly to understand unfamiliar open-source codebases.

Select your preferred model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, Fireworks, or local Ollama).
The claim that Google's Open Knowledge Format v0.2 release will be fully backwards-compatible with OpenWiki's deterministic front matter pass.
General-purpose memory is finally possible. Models got long enough context and good enough at synthesis that maintaining a knowledge base stopped being a research project.
The quality ceiling right now is the prompt, not the model. Most of the bad pages we've seen trace back to us asking for the wrong thing, not the model failing to deliver it.
